title: zero order single peak
description: Zero-order depletion edge; peak position depends on initial coverage.

title: first order single peak
description: Clean first-order reference: start here; isolated peak and no baseline.

title: second order single peak
description: Second-order tail; a wider fitting interval matters.

title: fractional order 1p5
description: Phenomenological fixed non-integer order; not a coverage-dependent microscopic mechanism.

title: two overlapping peaks
description: Two independent additive states; single-state fitting can be misleading.

title: three overlapping peaks
description: Three independent additive states; the current GUI does not provide a three-state inverse model.

title: first order noisy
description: Independent Gaussian detector noise; compare residuals and try seeded Monte Carlo.

title: first order noisy baseline
description: Gaussian noise plus constant offset and linear drift; a constant-baseline fitter cannot model the drift.

title: challenging overlap drift
description: Overlapping different-order states, correlated noise and drift deliberately violate single-state/MC assumptions.

title: heating rate 0p5 K s
description: First-order heating-rate series; compare with first_order_single_peak.csv (1 K/s). Increasing beta shifts the maximum upward.

title: heating rate 2p0 K s
description: First-order heating-rate series; compare with first_order_single_peak.csv (1 K/s). Increasing beta shifts the maximum upward.

title: heating rate 5p0 K s
description: First-order heating-rate series; compare with first_order_single_peak.csv (1 K/s). Increasing beta shifts the maximum upward.

title: zero order coverage 0p25
description: Coverage series; compare with the corresponding single_peak file (coverage 1). First-order peak position is coverage-independent in this model; zero-order peaks shift.

title: first order coverage 0p25
description: Coverage series; compare with the corresponding single_peak file (coverage 1). First-order peak position is coverage-independent in this model; zero-order peaks shift.

title: zero order coverage 0p5
description: Coverage series; compare with the corresponding single_peak file (coverage 1). First-order peak position is coverage-independent in this model; zero-order peaks shift.

title: first order coverage 0p5
description: Coverage series; compare with the corresponding single_peak file (coverage 1). First-order peak position is coverage-independent in this model; zero-order peaks shift.

title: first order low noise
description: Fixed-seed iid Gaussian detector noise, 1% of the clean maximum; compare with the clean first-order reference.

title: first order moderate noise
description: Fixed-seed iid Gaussian detector noise, 2% of the clean maximum; compare with the clean first-order reference.

title: first order high noise
description: Fixed-seed iid Gaussian detector noise, 5% of the clean maximum; compare with the clean first-order reference.

title: two overlapping moderate noise
description: Independent additive physical states with 2% iid Gaussian detector noise; visible features alone do not establish the number of physical states.

title: three overlapping moderate noise
description: Independent additive physical states with 2% iid Gaussian detector noise; visible features alone do not establish the number of physical states.
